Defines a single relationship between a source package or part and a target resource. It specifies a unique identifier, the relationship type (defining its role), and the target URI.

The Relationships element is the root element of a relationship part (.rels) in an Open Packaging Conventions (OPC) package. It acts as a container for one or more Relationship elements that define associations between a source part and target resources.

definition: This element represents a single row in a worksheet's grid and acts as a container for the individual cells (c) within that row. It defines row-level properties including the 1-based row index (r), custom height (ht), style formatting index (s), outline level, and visibility states such as hidden or collapsed.

The sheetData element represents the table grid of a worksheet in a SpreadsheetML document. It acts as the container for all row and cell elements, organizing the actual cell data and formulas of the sheet.
This element represents an individual string in the Shared String Table. It can contain either a simple text value or a complex set of rich text runs with character-level formatting.

The sst element defines the Shared String Table, which stores a single unique copy of each text string used across all worksheets in the spreadsheet. Rather than repeating literal strings in individual cells, cells reference these strings by their zero-based index to optimize file size. It also records the total and unique count of strings in the workbook.
